top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) is a single identifiable invention, the magic-wavelength lattice that cancels the clock-transition light shift while holding many atoms free of Doppler and recoil broadening, followed by a measured, independently reproduced 1e-18 performance. Concept and decisive demonstration map onto two names without an arbitrary cut, and it already yields physics: many-body and collisional shifts, relativistic geodesy, constants and dark-matter searches. The citation must stay narrow (magic-wavelength lattice clock), the priority sequence with Lemonde, Ludlow, Bloom and Hinkley is unverified, and the pending redefinition of the second should not delay it. P002 (IceCube, Halzen and Karle) is a secure discovery of a diffuse high-energy neutrino flux and opens a new window, but the two-name credit is discretionary against a collaboration of hundreds, AMANDA and Baikal precursors and Yoshida, so it ranks second. No award ranks last because P001 is mature and defensible.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; I direct WACQT and work in superconducting circuits (circuit QED is not in this slate), and have no documented link to Katori, Ye, Halzen, Karle or Yoshida.
